Initial release of the DevOps Engineer skill.

- Senior-level coverage of the full infrastructure lifecycle: provisioning, config management, CI/CD, containers, orchestration, monitoring, incident response, and developer experience.
- Trigger-based mode selector: identifies relevant sub-disciplines (e.g., IaC, CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability) from user keywords before responding.
- Deep best practices and tooling guidance for Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Pulumi, Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and related tools.
- Strong emphasis on modern SRE practices—SLOs, error budgets, observability, and alerting—with pragmatic reliability guidance.
- Security-first guidance across IAM, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and drift detection.
